test_title: PYST 1: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with the appropriate article.

Had he possessed _______ foresight to anticipate such eventualities, the entire trajectory of the project might have altered dramatically.
solution:
The correct answer is '**the**'. 
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 
 
 
• The definite article "**the**" is used to refer to something specific that has already been mentioned or is well understood in the context. 
 
• In the given sentence, "**foresight**" is a specific quality, and the context implies that it is a known or significant concept being referred to. 
 
• Options 1, 2</str
